result.behaviour_summary: Added an opt-in matched-controls version v3 to idx-signals/idxsig/controls.py: the same seven features as v2 but with volatility as a QUINTILE placed ahead of market_cap (priority: price_band, liquidity quintile, volatility quintile, market_cap quintile [mirror era only, -1 elsewhere], momentum tercile, drawdown tercile, listing_age), relaxed from the last feature to MIN_POOL=5 by the unchanged matched_draws loop. Implementation: VERSIONS['v3'] plus a per-version override table FEATURE_OVERRIDES and a feature(name, version) accessor; features() reads the volatility bucket count from feature('volatility', version) (3 for v1/v2, 5 for v3) and coverage() takes the feature definition from feature(name, version) so the v3 report says 'quintile'. FEATURES, VERSIONS['v1'], VERSIONS['v2'], MIN_POOL, _bucket, _rolling, _codes, matched_draws, levels and level_names are untouched; the default version everywhere is still 'v2'. The module docstring documents why v3 exists (volatility is the only measured pre-event separator; under v2 it is a coarse tercile ranked below market_cap and 28% of attempted signals on the recorded IDX trading run were never matched on it). No change to backtest.py was needed: it already passes cfg.controls_version into features(), matched_draws(), VERSIONS[], level_names() and coverage(), and records it at summary['harness']['controls'] and summary['random_matched']['controls']['version'] (verified by a synthetic end-to-end test). _codes packs buckets base 8, and the largest code digit is buckets+1 = 6, so the quintile fits.

result.defaults_unchanged_evidence: Three independent checks. (1) Fingerprint script (scratchpad/v2_fingerprint.py, outside the repo) run against the worktree BEFORE and AFTER the change: sha256 of every v1 and v2 feature array (name, bytes, dtype) on three synthetic markets (plain; ipo+delist+shares_until; small), sha256 of matched_draws output (tickers + level_used) under a fixed rng, sha256 of coverage() JSON for IDX and US band names, the as_traded US price_band array, level_names, and sha256 of summary['random_matched'] plus summary['harness']['controls'] from run_synthetic for controls_version v1, v2 and the default. `diff v2_before.json v2_after.json` printed nothing -> "FINGERPRINTS IDENTICAL". (2) tests/test_controls_v3.py carries a verbatim frozen copy of the pre-change features()/_bucket/_rolling (as at ae2cbee) and asserts array-and-dtype equality with the live module for v1 and v2 on three synthetic markets, with IDX and US band edges and on the as_traded path; asserts matched_draws for v2 gives identical draws and levels from live vs frozen features under the same seed; asserts VERSIONS['v1'], VERSIONS['v2'], level_names('v2'), MIN_POOL, FEATURES['volatility'] (3 buckets, 'tercile' wording) and coverage() priorities/descriptions for v2 equal their literal pre-change values, and that feature(name, 'v1'|'v2') returns the very FEATURES object; asserts RunConfig default controls_version is 'v2' and a default synthetic run records 'v2' at harness.controls and random_matched.controls.version with the v2 method text. (3) The 244 pre-existing tests pass unchanged and `python3 -m idxsig verify-runs` reports OK. The diff itself shows the only executable changes on the v1/v2 path are `vol_buckets = feature('volatility', version).buckets` (3 for v1/v2) replacing the literal 3, and `f = feature(name, version)` replacing `FEATURES[name]` in coverage (same object for v1/v2).
needs_other_file: idx-signals/idxsig/cli.py line 91: `p_run.add_argument("--controls-version", choices=("v2", "v1"), default="v2", ...)` rejects `--controls-version v3` from the command line; add "v3" to choices (default must stay "v2"). Programmatic callers (RunConfig, e3/e4-style harness_config reading protocol['harness']['controls_version']) already work with 'v3'.

idx-signals/idxsig/e1.py line 151: Study calls controls.features(m, "v2", ...) with a hard-coded version; the E5 draft's detection stage ('e1.Study pool extended to volatility quintile') needs the e1 owner to pass 'v3' (or add the quintile to its pool keys) there - not changed here.
open_concerns: The '28% of IDX attempts never matched on volatility under v2' figure in the module docstring is quoted from the reference RECOMMENDATION.md ('on the recorded IDX run 28% of attempts were never matched on volatility under v2'); I did not recompute it from any recorded run (no real data was loaded, per the standing rules). It is stated as the protocol draft's rationale, not as a measured result of this change.

The v3 relaxation ladder drops listing_age, drawdown, momentum, market_cap, then volatility; in the IDX mirror era market_cap is known, so a pool short of 5 names at level 'price_band+liquidity+volatility+market_cap' relaxes to 'price_band+liquidity+volatility' - the intended behaviour, but note that outside the mirror era (market_cap == -1 for everyone) level 3 and level 4 pools are identical, exactly as v2's levels 4 and 5 were.

controls.features() still returns the full v2-style dict for an unrecognised version string (pre-existing behaviour; VERSIONS[version] in matched_draws/coverage raises KeyError later). I left that untouched to keep the v2 path byte-identical.
Nothing in this branch runs a harness on real data; whether v3 changes any recorded conclusion is for the E5 Stage 0/1 runs to show.
